rationale: The agent correctly verified identity using full name + ZIP, reviewed the user’s orders, confirmed the exact changes and payment method before proceeding, and used the proper tools. However, after receiving confirmation, the agent executed the return first, which changed the order status to “return requested” and blocked the exchange. The user wanted both actions and explicitly preferred the exchange if only one could be done. The agent should have prioritized the exchange (which appears eligible for a delivered order) or warned that initiating the return first could prevent the exchange. Because the exchange was not completed due to the agent’s sequence of actions—even though it was likely permissible—the request was not fully completed in line with the policy’s pass bar. Product details and the guidance to place a new order were accurate and supported by tool data, but the core failure to complete the exchange results in a fail verdict.
